title: 第15章 陈小雨的恳求
novel_title: 栽赃陷害我？我请你们吃正义铁拳(猫饵)
content_zh: 陈小雨闻言紧紧咬住下唇，清澈的双眸中透着坚定，回道：“那个欺负我们韩老师的坏人，就是我们学校的校长！”林奕不禁大吃一惊：“小雨，你确定你说的坏人，是你们学校的校长？”陈小雨绷紧小脸蛋，重重点头道：“对，我确定是他！好几次我都看到，我们韩老师哭着从他办公室里出来。”看着陈小雨严肃的神情，林奕瞬间意识到，这起事件的严重性可能比他预想的还要糟糕。清河乡中学的校长还兼任着乡教育组长，要是真有大问题，那塌方的可能就不只是他一个人，还会连带出一大批利益相关的蛀虫。“书记叔叔，您就帮帮我们韩老师吧！”见林奕沉着脸不说话，陈小雨还以为他不想帮忙，眼圈渐渐发红，恳求道：“我们韩老师真的很可怜，她从小在单亲家庭长大，妈妈常年住院治病。”“韩老师每个月的工资，全花在给妈妈治病买药上，自己每天就吃馒头咸菜。”“她真的是个好老师，对我们大家都很好，不该受这些委屈和欺负的！”“小雨，叔叔没说不帮你们老师！”林奕一脸郑重地承诺：“你放心，这件事我一定会亲自调查！”“如果查明你们老师确实被欺负了，我一定帮她主持正义、讨回公道！”“好，那我们可说定了，不准骗人！”陈小雨咬紧唇瓣，目光格外认真。“放心，叔叔从不骗人，一定说到做到。”看着陈小雨认真的小模样，林奕越发觉得自己身上的职责沉甸甸的。……回到乡委大院，林奕立刻把乡委办主任刘爱民叫进了办公室。刘爱民刚过四十岁，在清河乡政府算是老资历干部，可惜时运不济，几次提拔副乡长都没成，之后便开始摆烂。直到林奕下放到清河乡，他的心思才重新活泛起来。不仅主动向林奕站队靠拢，还提供了不少乡长赵连生等人的黑材料。尤其是林奕拿下傅彪后，刘爱民更是把林奕当成了亲爹一般照顾。但凡涉及林奕的事，无论大小他都亲自操办。就连林奕的生活用品，也都是他亲自挑选购买，从不假手于人。对于刘爱民，林奕谈不上欣赏，但也不讨厌。这人虽是官迷，却有几分个人能力，不然也坐不稳乡委办主任的位置这么久。总体评价就是：有用，但不能委以大用。可以帮他在仕途上稍作提拔，却绝不能放在关键岗位，否则很容易被权力腐化。刘爱民走进书记办公室，先有眼力见地给林奕续上热水，才毕恭毕敬地问：“书记，您找我有事？”“爱民同志，咱们清河中学的校长孙志远，你熟悉吗？”林奕面色平静地问道。“书记，工作上经常接触，我对孙校长还算熟悉，也大概了解他的为人。”刘爱民一边悄悄观察林奕的表情变化，一边小心翼翼地回答。林奕点点头：“好，既然你了解他，就给我说说，孙志远是个什么样的人？”刘爱民是个聪明人，一听这话就明白领导的意思，脸上表情瞬间凝重起来：“书记，其实孙校长这个人争议很大！”“乡上不少教育系统的基层骨干都向乡委反映过，说他在学校里独断专行、大搞一言堂，漠视其他人的意见，用权力代替组织规则，破坏校园民主氛围和教育生态。”“而且我还听说，他喜好封建迷信，把自己的办公室改成了风水阵，说这样能提升官运。”“既然乡里面都知道他有问题，为什么不派纪委调查？”林奕眉头紧紧蹙起。“书记，不是没查过，只是上面有压力，乡上根本查不下去啊！”刘爱民苦笑着解释。“说说看，都是来自哪方的压力呀？”林奕放下茶杯，眼中泛起冷光道。“书记，孙志远的亲妹妹孙洁，是县委办副主任。”刘爱民凑近办公桌，压低了声音道。“呵，难怪查不下去。有个县委办副主任的亲妹妹当靠山，自然不怕乡里面查他。”林奕忍不住嘲讽冷笑。“书记，您不是本地人，不知道那位孙洁主任可不简单！”刘爱民摇头感叹：“她只用了短短五年，就从县委招待所的前台招待，一路破格提拔成县委办副主任，深得好几位县委常委的信任。”“孙志远能来清河乡中学当校长，也是孙洁靠着人际关系运作的结果。”刘爱民的话虽没明说，但话里话外都在暗示，孙洁背后有人撑腰，而且可能不止一位县委领导。不然一个前台招待的小服务员，怎么可能在五年内破格提拔成县委办副主任？这背后要是没猫腻，才真叫见了鬼。“哼，孙志远受清河乡委领导，若他的行为触犯党纪国法，我们清河乡委就有权严肃追责处置——这是组织赋予我们的权力，不用惧怕任何牛鬼蛇神！”林奕冷哼一声，眼中带着冷意，当场对刘爱民下达指示：“下午，你陪我去学校走访调研，我倒要看看，那个孙志远是怎么在学校里大搞封建迷信的！”
content_en: Chen Xiaoyu bit her lower lip tightly when she heard this, with determination in her clear eyes, and replied: "The bad guy who bullied our teacher Han is the principal of our school!" Lin Yi couldn't help being shocked: "Xiaoyu, are you sure the bad guy you are talking about is the principal of your school?" Chen XiaoyuYu tightened his face and nodded heavily: "Yes, I'm sure it's him! I saw our teacher Han come out of his office crying several times." Looking at Chen Xiaoyu's serious expression, Lin Yi instantly realized that the seriousness of this incident might be worse than he expected.The principal of Qinghe Township Middle School also serves as the head of the township education team. If there is a big problem, he may not be the only one who suffers the collapse, but also a large number of interested parties."Uncle Secretary, please help our Teacher Han!" Seeing Lin Yi's sullen face and not speaking, Chen Xiaoyu thought he didn't want to help. His eye circles gradually turned red and he begged: "Our Teacher Han is really pitiful. She grew up in a single-parent family, and her mother has been hospitalized for treatment all year round." "Teacher Han's monthly salary is all spent on buying medicine for her mother's illness, and she eats steamed buns and pickles every day." "She is really a good teacher.You are very kind to all of us, and you should not be subjected to these grievances and bullying!" "Xiaoyu, I didn't say I wouldn't help your teacher!" Lin Yi solemnly promised: "Don't worry, I will investigate this matter personally!" "If it is found that your teacher has been bullied, I will definitely help her get justice!" "Okay, then we have decided not to lie!" Chen Xiaoyu bit her lips and looked extremely serious."Don't worry, uncle never lies. He will always keep his word." Looking at Chen Xiaoyu's serious appearance, Lin Yi felt more and more heavy with his responsibilities.... Returning to the township committee compound, Lin Yi immediately called Liu Aimin, director of the township committee office, into the office.Liu Aimin had just turned 40 and was considered a senior cadre in the Qinghe Township government. Unfortunately, he had bad luck and failed to promote him to deputy township chief several times. After that, he began to fail.It wasn't until Lin Yi was sent to Qinghe Township that his thoughts became alive again.Not only did he take the initiative to join Lin Yi's side, he also provided a lot of dirty information about the township head Zhao Liansheng and others.Especially after Lin Yi captured Fu Biao, Liu Aimin took care of Lin Yi as if he were his own father.He personally handles everything involving Lin Yi, no matter how big or small.Even Lin Yi's daily necessities are selected and purchased by him personally, never by others.Lin Yi couldn't say he admired Liu Aimin, but he didn't dislike him either.Although this person is an official fan, he has some personal abilities, otherwise he would not be able to hold the position of director of the township committee office for so long.The overall evaluation is: useful, but cannot be entrusted to great use.You can help him get a slight promotion in his official career, but he must not be placed in a key position, otherwise he will be easily corrupted by power.Liu Aimin walked into the secretary's office. He first offered Lin Yi hot water with discernment, and then asked respectfully: "Secretary, do you have something to do with me?" "Comrade Aimin, are you familiar with Sun Zhiyuan, the principal of Qinghe Middle School?" Lin Yi asked calmly."Secretary, I often interact with him at work. I am quite familiar with Principal Sun and have a general understanding of his personality." Liu Aimin answered cautiously while quietly observing the changes in Lin Yi's expression.Lin Yi nodded: "Okay, since you know him, tell me, what kind of person is Sun Zhiyuan?" Liu Aimin is a smart man. He understood what the leader meant when he heard this, and his expression instantly became solemn: "Secretary, in fact, Principal Sun is a very controversial person!" "Many grassroots backbones of the education system in the countryside have reported to the township committee that he is arbitrary in the school.He ignored the opinions of others, replaced organizational rules with power, and destroyed the democratic atmosphere and educational ecology of the campus."And I also heard that he liked feudal superstition and changed his office into a Feng Shui array, saying that it would improve his official career.""Since everyone in the township knows that he has problems, why not send the disciplinary inspection committee to investigate?"Lin Yi frowned."Secretary, it's not that we haven't checked, it's just that there is pressure from above and the countryside can't carry out the investigation at all!" Liu Aimin explained with a wry smile."Tell me, where does the pressure come from?" Lin Yi put down the tea cup and said with a cold light in his eyes."Secretary, Sun Zhiyuan's sister Sun Jie is the deputy director of the county party committee office." Liu Aimin approached the desk and lowered his voice."Ha, no wonder the investigation can't be carried out. He has the sister of the deputy director of the county party committee as his backer, so he is naturally not afraid of being investigated in the township." Lin Yi couldn't help but sneer."Secretary, you are not a local. You don't know that Director Sun Jie is not simple!" Liu Aimin shook his head and sighed: "In just five years, she was promoted from the front desk of the county party committee guest house to the deputy director of the county party committee office. She won the favor of several county party committee members."Sun Zhiyuan came to be the principal of Qinghe Township Middle School because Sun Jie relied on interpersonal relationships."Although Liu Aimin didn't say it clearly, he hinted that there was someone behind Sun Jie, and there might be more than one county party leader.Otherwise, how could a waiter at the front desk be promoted to deputy director of the county party committee office within five years?If there wasn't something fishy behind this, it would really be a ghost."Huh, Sun Zhiyuan is under the leadership of the Qinghe Township Committee. If his behavior violates party discipline and state law, our Qinghe Township Committee has the right to seriously investigate and deal with it - this is the power given to us by the organization. We don't need to be afraid of any ghosts and monsters!" Lin Yi snorted coldly, with a cold look in his eyes, and gave instructions to Liu Aimin on the spot: "In the afternoon, you accompany me to the school for investigation and investigation. I want to see how Sun Zhiyuan practices feudal superstition in the school!"
